text_block_list.text:
Relying on her own strength,
Matikanefukukitaru
makes her mark on
the Hakodate Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After commemorating her victory at
Goryokaku
Fort, she reveals that there's
a certain race she
hopes to run in.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Instead of letting her fortune slips do
the honors,
Matikanefukukitaru chooses
to aim for the Arima
Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She stokes her passion, determined to
earn her
spot on her own merits, unlike
what happened
with the Takarazuka
Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
